title: run.skill.md should use write_file after patch_file failure
description: During run 3853e12f, two patch_file attempts on .github/workflows/release.yml failed before write_file was used as a fallback. The skill currently recommends patch_file for <20-line changes but provides no guidance on escalating after a failure. Each failed patch_file call increments tool_errors, reducing rubric_score. Adding an explicit escalation rule would prevent these redundant failures on subsequent runs.
proposed_resolution: Add to run.skill.md Phase 3: 'If patch_file returns a failure result for a file, do not retry patch_file on that file â€” fall back immediately to write_file with the complete new content.' This reduces expected tool_errors per run by ~2 when patch_file is unreliable on a given file type.
